instruction: Change the font of all section headings (Heading 2) in this document to Arial.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(15); pyautogui.press("down", presses=8, interval=0.01); time.sleep(1); pyautogui.scroll(-2)
import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully inserted an image from Desktop into the document at the cursor position using Insert > Image menu in 6 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate LibreOffice Writer menus, use Insert > Image, browse file system, select and insert files, interact with document editing UI
metadata.task_rationale: Tests document formatting capability - changing heading fonts requires selecting text and modifying font properties, a related but different Writer editing task using the same document setup.
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing font of all Heading 2 paragraphs to Arial. Getter reads the docx and extracts font names for each Heading 2 paragraph. Metric gives partial credit per heading with correct font.

scoring_breakdown.per_heading: 1/N each - Each Heading 2 paragraph with correct Arial font (N = total Heading 2 count)

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly identifies Heading 2 paragraphs by style name and extracts run-level font names.
Metric correctly accesses expected parameter directly (expected.get('expected_font')) consistent with type='rule' behavior.
Postconfig saves the file with Ctrl+S before evaluation, ensuring fresh state.
Partial credit scoring (correct/total headings) is appropriate for this multi-element task.

ISSUE: Getter only checks run.font.name (direct formatting) and misses style-inherited fonts. If the user changes the Heading 2 style's font to Arial instead of directly formatting each run, run.font.name returns None, the fonts set is empty, and the metric scores 0.0 despite the task being correctly completed. This is a significant false-negative risk since modifying the paragraph style is a valid and common approach in LibreOffice Writer.
MINOR: Empty headings (no runs) would result in an empty fonts list and not count as correct, which is acceptable behavior.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Getter should fall back to checking the paragraph style's font when run.font.name is None. For example: if no run has a direct font, check p.style.font.name to detect style-level font changes.
Consider also checking the document's default style font as an additional fallback for inherited fonts.
